description: This file defines an internal interface 'IClusterManifestSystemTarget' for accessing the cluster manifest, along with the 'ClusterManifestUpdate' class that encapsulates updates to the cluster manifest, including version info, silo manifests, and active server status.

classes.name: ClusterManifestUpdate
classes.description: Represents an update to the cluster manifest, including version, silo manifests, and active server inclusion status.

methods.name: GetClusterManifest
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current cluster manifest.

methods.name: GetClusterManifestUpdate
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an updated cluster manifest if newer than the specified version.
